headline: A reviewer decision should be readable after the moment passes.
copy: Every approval handoff needs owner, source id, decision, risk, reason, and blocked fields so the product never silently upgrades itself.

steps.title: Assign
steps.copy: Name the reviewer lane and owner.

steps.title: Gate
steps.copy: Keep production fields blocked until ready.

candidates.title: Approve steady action
candidates.reason: Suitable for beginner calm reflection with visible boundary.

record.title: Steady action
record.summary: Supports practical answers about steady action while avoiding promises of guaranteed calm.
record.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

candidates.packet:
Reviewer receipt
Owner: source reviewer
Decision: approved for private demo
Reason: source supports steady action language; boundary visible
Blocked: public translation display, medical framing, ritual instruction
Next: allow adapter draft in private demo

candidates.title: Approve category correction
candidates.reason: Strong public-interest example with clear category correction.

record.title: Oppenheimer category correction
record.summary: Supports correcting the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
record.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.
